item.title: Why Iran seeks permanent end to war, not temporary ceasefire?
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Republic of Iran has emphasized that the key objective in the ongoing war is to eliminate the threat and secure a decisive and permanent end to the war, stressing that a temporary ceasefire without guarantees against renewed aggression would not provide lasting stability.

Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Republic of Iran has emphasized that the key objective in the ongoing war is to eliminate the threat and secure a decisive and permanent end to the war, stressing that a temporary ceasefire without guarantees against renewed aggression would not provide lasting stability.

item.title: Envoy says IAEA BoG resolution not effective
item.description: London, IRNA — Iran’s permanent ambassador to the United Nations and other international organizations in Vienna, Reza Najafi, has criticized Western nations for politicizing the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Board of Governors and stressed that there wouldn’t be any actual effect from this resolution.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86261510/Envoy-says-IAEA-BoG-resolution-not-effective

item.title: Diplomatic gains cannot be reduced to oil prices: FM spokesperson
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has rejected criticism that announcing a joint meeting between Iran and the Persian Gulf states contributed to a decline in global oil prices, saying diplomatic decisions cannot be made based on a single factor and that the priority is to secure national interests at the appropriate time.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86261602/Diplomatic-gains-cannot-be-reduced-to-oil-prices-FM-spokesperson

Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has rejected criticism that announcing a joint meeting between Iran and the Persian Gulf states contributed to a decline in global oil prices, saying diplomatic decisions cannot be made based on a single factor and that the priority is to secure national interests at the appropriate time.
